question: In illustrations of Otto, his eyes are a deep blue. In the text, I think they were noted as being green several times. Which is it? I’m thinking of drawing an illustration, so I’m wondering.
answer: Otsuka-sensei is correct, so it’s blue. He’s probably shorter than he was in the web version, as well. At the point I was coming up with those details, I didn’t think that Otto would hang around, so my apologies.
